name: WLF_LI_BOOKINGS
description: Table to store details of activity bookings

columns.name: BOOKING_ID
columns.description: Booking Id pk

columns.name: BOOKING_NUMBER
columns.description: UserKey for uniquely identifying Learning Booking.

columns.name: ADHOC_ITEM_DESC
columns.description: ADHOC Resource Description

columns.name: LEARNING_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Activity learning item id

columns.name: BOOKED_ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates what type of booked item this is (resource, person, etc)

columns.name: BOOKED_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Can be a resource_id or person_id

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Primary Flag

columns.name: ADHOC_ITEM_NAME
columns.description: Adhoc resource name

columns.name: ADHOC_ITEM_QUANTITY
columns.description: ADHOC_ITEM_QUANTITY

columns.name: HOST_URL
columns.description: Vilt host url value

columns.name: VILT_PRODUCT
columns.description: Webex product type

columns.name: VILT_CALL_TIME
columns.description: Vilt call timestamp

columns.name: VILT_CALL_STATUS
columns.description: Vilt call status

columns.name: VILT_CALL_LOG
columns.description: Vilt call log

columns.name: SESSION_KEY
columns.description: Session key

columns.name: RECORDING_LOCATION
columns.description: URL for the recording of the meeting

columns.name: OPEN_TIME
columns.description: The amount of time before the meeting starts in which the VILT learner can join the meeting

columns.name: RECORDING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the VILT ACCOUNT associated to the ILT activity has recordings or not. Y/N value

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
